experiments.scope: Binding 12 x 2^19 table, six lanes, first-six retention, selected a0 window and kept CV class at reduced size. Trials 0..3 draw SHAKE first blocks until ((cv0>>24)&63)==12, choose r/ustart and 512 SEL sub-blocks from the seed, build from 2^17 consecutive u and scan 2^17 a0. The combined tag/C1 test, ordered lane tree, postfilters and step3b run on each candidate. Tag claws are compared with an independent retained-entry search and real E16; C1 claws and every postfilter flag are compared with real-word definitions. These sparse trials have about ten claws, so they check semantics rather than rates. Trial 4 is the positive P8 step3b control. Trial 5 exhausts tag classes and 16,128 C1 lane cases. Trial 6 compares 16 bitsliced batches with the scalar predicate and checks the 218-operation program bound. Trial 7 samples window rates on 2^15 C1/C2 draws. Trial 8 samples class F7 rates on 2^15 draws with 16 cv0 values per group. Trial 9 invokes the actual walk on all 63 nonempty guard masks, checking order, additive charges 6,6,6,8,8,8 and maximum 18 per read. Trial 10 recomputes the full integer ledger with mean 7, worst 18 and one-time 2^24 initialization. Trials 12..255 return no pair. Numeric observations are participant reports. Historical 24 native14-versus15 comparisons remain in Appendix U. Current Appendix X has12 full native12 tree/scalar versus filtered14 comparisons, exact census and memory receipts. Historical15-column and current12-column reference/bounded comparisons are evidence-only, never procedure phases or procedure inputs; only physical 12-column production runs witness online memory. Trial11 is a finite rotation-transfer diagnostic: actual P and production build_table over all8192 rotations,three cyclic starts,24words/start; compares retained-word multiplicities with an independent bucket/cyclic-rank definition,then checks conservative first-moment and epoch pmax arithmetic. No deep-rate or independence inference.
experiments.hypothesis: The exact finite checks preserve the current construction's claw and good-pair sets, ascending lane order and step3b outputs. The ordered tree has the stated exhaustive operation bounds. Its table-wide mean 7 charge additionally uses H1's equal C1 mass per retained entry and first-six prefix retention, not an empirical timing average.

Claws, C1 claws, real E16 and postfilter flags are checked against independent definitions; both members are traced through the shallow rows. Trial 4 checks the known P8 step3b pair.
